versions.changelog:
guaikei-douyin-collect-public-data v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for collecting and analyzing public Douyin (抖音) data.
- Supports keyword search and sorting, author post collection, video/comment analysis, and realtime trending topics.
- Designed for use in content research, competitor monitoring, public sentiment analysis, and trend tracking.
- Does not provide editing, publishing, or private data collection; only public data is accessible.
- Works via command-line interface with environment variable configuration for secure API access.
